ios.desc:
Make room for the reading you care about. Fiery Feeds brings your RSS subscriptions and saved articles together on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with layouts, fonts and colors you control.

Sync with your preferred service, use iCloud, or keep a local account. Fiery Feeds Pro adds Hot Links, Smart Views and full-text extraction to help you find what matters and read offline.

- Smart Views -
Hot Links - Find pages frequently linked in your articles.
Low and High Frequency - Separate quiet and busy feeds.
Long and Short Articles - Filter by article length.
Must Read - Keep important feeds together.
Recents - See today's articles.

- Text Extraction -
Read available full article text, including offline. Choose feed text, extracted text or the original website for each feed.

- Share Extension -
Save links to read later and subscribe to feeds from Safari and other compatible apps.

- Customizable -
Choose fonts, text sizes, colors and layouts. Create color themes with the included editor or browse the theme directory.

- Smart Searches -
Save searches by content, title, publication date, posting frequency and more.

- Home Widgets -
See articles, Hot Links and unread counts. Mark articles read or starred from supported widgets.

- Article Summaries and Translations -
Summarize and translate articles. Availability varies by device, OS, language and provider; external AI services require your own API key.

- Keyboard Shortcuts and VoiceOver -
Navigate with keyboard shortcuts and VoiceOver support.

- Custom URL Sharing -
Create URL actions and email templates for sharing articles.

- Feed Management -
Subscribe, organize feeds and folders, and work with multiple accounts.

- Even more -
Horizontal article swiping - Move between articles with a swipe.
Flexible read marking - Mark read on scroll, by age, or above or below an article.
Three Pane View - More room for reading on iPad and Mac.

- Supported Feed Accounts -
Feedly, Feedbin, Inoreader, NewsBlur, FreshRSS, Miniflux, Feeder, Gobbler, FeedHQ, BazQux, The Old Reader, Tiny Tiny RSS, Nextcloud News, Fever, iCloud and local accounts.

- Supported Read Later Accounts -
Instapaper, Raindrop.io, Karakeep, Wallabag, Pinboard, Paper Press, iCloud and local accounts. Features vary by account and service.

- Fiery Feeds Pro -
